meta: Plumber for Magnolia Park in Oakley, CA: who handles the water meter, the shutoff and the line to your house, plus repairs on your side. Call (888) 910-8644.
lead: Plumbing help for Magnolia Park, in the central part of Oakley, CA, a short drive from downtown. Call to describe the problem and arrange a visit.
intro: Magnolia Park is a residential area in central Oakley, ZIP 94561. City environmental records list it as a residential and mixed-use development. We have no reliable record of when each street was built, so this page does not guess at pipe materials or ages.

The most useful thing for a Magnolia Park homeowner is knowing who is responsible for what. A leak before the meter, a leak after it and a sewer backup are three different calls, and this page sorts them out.

paras: Diablo Water District supplies most of Oakley, and the City of Brentwood supplies some areas near the Brentwood boundary. Your water bill names your supplier, and that is the quickest way to know whose line runs to your meter.
Do not rely on a map or on a neighbor's answer. Two houses on the same street can occasionally be served differently near a boundary, so the bill is the evidence.
The usual split in California is simple. The supplier owns the line to the meter and the homeowner owns everything after it.

sections.h2: Know these three spots before an emergency
paras: Find them on a calm day and show everyone in the house.

items.d: Usually near where the line enters the house or at the meter box. Turn it fully to close the water to the whole property.
Toilets and sinks have small wall valves. Closing one stops a single fixture without losing water everywhere.
The cold inlet valve on top of the tank stops water into the heater when it leaks. See [[water-heater-repair|water heater repair]] for what comes next.

paras: Ironhouse Sanitary District runs the public sewer, and the homeowner owns the private lateral from the house to the main. If the district sees a backup, it can say whether the main is clear. Our [[drain-cleaning|drain cleaning]] page covers clearing the private side, and a camera shows what is in the line.

a: Yes. Dispatch takes calls for Oakley, ZIP 94561, including Magnolia Park. Give your street and describe the problem when you call.

faqs.q: How do I find out who supplies my water?
a: Look at your water bill. It names the supplier, which is Diablo Water District for most of Oakley and the City of Brentwood for some areas near the boundary.

faqs.q: Who fixes a leak in front of my house at the meter?
a: The water supplier handles the line up to the meter. If water is escaping after the meter, it is on the homeowner's side. A plumber can tell which side it is.
Look near the point where the supply enters the house, in the garage or on an exterior wall, or in the meter box at the curb. Practice closing it once so it is not stiff in an emergency.

faqs.q: Can Ironhouse Sanitary District clear my house drain?
a: The district manages the public sewer. The private lateral from the house to the main belongs to the owner, so a blocked house drain is normally cleared by a plumber.

cta_mid: Not sure whether a leak is yours or the supplier's? Shut off the main, then call dispatch and describe where the water is.
cta_end: Leak, low pressure or a backup in Magnolia Park? Call dispatch to describe it, and we tell you which side of the meter it is on.
